text: This pilot study compared the growth of basil seedlings under red-dominant and blue-dominant LED light. Seedlings were grown in matched conditions and monitored for three weeks, with height and leaf development recorded. Seedlings under blue-dominant light appeared sturdier, while those under red-dominant light looked taller and more elongated. The very small sample limits conclusions, so larger, replicated experiments are needed.
task: Write an abstract for a fictional small study comparing plant growth under two colors of light. Mention the small sample and avoid invented numerical results.
